title: Ordering Pizza
statementMd:
It's another Start[c]up finals, and that means there is pizza to order for the onsite contestants. There are only 2 types of pizza (obviously not, but let's just pretend for the sake of the problem), and all pizzas contain exactly $*S*$ slices.

It is known that the $*i*$-th contestant will eat $*s*_{*i*}$ slices of pizza, and gain $*a*_{*i*}$ happiness for each slice of type 1 pizza they eat, and $*b*_{*i*}$ happiness for each slice of type 2 pizza they eat. We can order any number of type 1 and type 2 pizzas, but we want to buy the minimum possible number of pizzas for all of the contestants to be able to eat their required number of slices. Given that restriction, what is the maximum possible total happiness that can be achieved?

## Input

The first line of input will contain integers $*N*$ and $*S*$ $(1 ≤ *N* ≤ 10^{5}, 1 ≤ *S* ≤ 10^{5})$, the number of contestants and the number of slices per pizza, respectively. $*N*$ lines follow.

The $*i*$-th such line contains integers $*s*_{*i*}$, $*a*_{*i*}$, and $*b*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}, 1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}, 1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5})$, the number of slices the $*i*$-th contestant will eat, the happiness they will gain from each type 1 slice they eat, and the happiness they will gain from each type 2 slice they eat, respectively.

## Output

Print the maximum total happiness that can be achieved.

## Note

In the first example, you only need to buy one pizza. If you buy a type 1 pizza, the total happiness will be $3·5 + 4·6 + 5·9 = 84$, and if you buy a type 2 pizza, the total happiness will be $3·7 + 4·7 + 5·5 = 74$.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

又到了 Start[c]up 决赛，这意味着需要为参加现场比赛的选手订购披萨。披萨只有 2 种类型（显然并非如此，但为了题目方便我们暂且这样假设），并且每个披萨恰好包含 $*S*$ 片。

已知第 $*i*$ 位选手将吃掉 $*s*_{*i*}$ 片披萨；每吃一片 1 号披萨，他们将获得 $*a*_{*i*}$ 点快乐值；每吃一片 2 号披萨，他们将获得 $*b*_{*i*}$ 点快乐值。我们可以订购任意数量的 1 号和 2 号披萨，但希望购买的披萨总数尽可能少，以保证所有选手都能吃到他们所需数量的披萨。在满足这一限制的前提下，能够获得的总快乐值最大是多少？

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含整数 $*N*$ 和 $*S*$ $(1 ≤ *N* ≤ 10^{5}, 1 ≤ *S* ≤ 10^{5})$，分别表示选手数量和每个披萨包含的披萨片数。接下来有 $*N*$ 行。

其中第 $*i*$ 行包含整数 $*s*_{*i*}$、$*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}, 1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}, 1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5})$，分别表示第 $*i*$ 位选手将吃掉的披萨片数、每吃一片 1 号披萨所获得的快乐值，以及每吃一片 2 号披萨所获得的快乐值。

## 输出格式

输出能够获得的最大总快乐值。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，只需要购买一个披萨。如果购买 1 号披萨，总快乐值为 $3·5 + 4·6 + 5·9 = 84$；如果购买 2 号披萨，总快乐值为 $3·7 + 4·7 + 5·5 = 74$。
